message: 七大猫魔少女
Throwing all our strength at her paid off, and we somehow managed to stop her in her tracks.
However, dragging this battle out any longer would honestly be rough. Everyone's legs are shaking from exhaustion.

name: Pasta
message: 「No way, nya~~. Putting up this much of a fight when you're just humans is so cheeky, nyan……」

name: Sally
message: 「There's a demon here too~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And an angel, too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm not an angel!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「An angel, a demon, and humans joining forces…… You're definitely plotting something, nyan!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the ones plotting something, aren't you!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, what are you after?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'm not stupid enough to go out of my way to tell you that, nyan」

name: Shio
message: 「If thou refusest to speak, then brace thyself with dignity! I shall personally send thee to the hereafter!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Eek!! Pointing a blade at me is dangerous, nyan!」

name: Pasta
message: 「A pistol is even more dangerous, nyaaa!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a rifle, actually.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyau~~. If it's come to this, bye-bye means victory, nyan」

name: Pasta
message: 「Virus-nyama, who's way, way stroooonger than Pasta, is gonna beat you guys to a pulp, nyaaa!」

name: Sally
message: 「So, what's next?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Y-You'll pay for this, nyan」

name: Sally
message: 「Like hell I will.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyagiiii! Don't make fun of me, you low-ranking demon, nyaaaan. Comfort me, Virus-nyamaaaa」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nice one, Sally-chan.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hehe~\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She is a grand veteran of playing the punching bag, after all.」

name: Sally
message: 「Praise me more~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Virus-nyama. Who on earth is that?」

name: Ria
message: 「I think 'nyama' is probably an honorific\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「Virus, Virus... Hmmmmm」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, I remember! Pretty sure he's one of the Seven Demon Generals」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Sally-chan. Could you tell us the names of the Seven Demon Generals, just as many as you know?」

name: Sally
message: 「There's Boss. And Pasta from earlier. Plus Virus, and...」

name: Ria
message: 「What about the other four?」

name: Sally
message: 「Including Pasta, the rest aren't really famous anyway. I totally forgot 'em」

name: Ria
message: 「I see...」
Or rather, it likely meant that 'Virus' was by far the most famous among the demons.
That notoriety was also proof of strength.

name: Synn
message: 「I think Pasta is a pretty strong demon too. You're telling me there's a demon even stronger than him...」

name: Sally
message: 「Virus is supposedly super strong. Word has it he even indiscriminately defeated both the angel and the demon rumored to be the strongest at the time」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek! Even an angel?!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. In fact, he's rumored to be the strongest demon in the Demon World, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If someone like that comes here, we're in huge trouble!!」

name: Misa
message: 「If the Human World ends up conquered or something...」

name: Synn
message: 「Before that, wouldn't he conquer the Demon World first?」

name: Sally
message: 「Conquering the Demon World wouldn't be any fun, I'm telling ya」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case... it wouldn't be strange if he targeted this Human World next」

name: Helena
message: 「Keep your hasty assumptions to yourself. You'll only panic everyone」

name: Synn
message: 「S-sorry. I just blurted it out」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, it seems the mastermind has finally shown themselves. There's still so much we don't know, though--」

name: Helena
message: 「Sorry, I'm going to stop by the library on my way back. Everyone else can head off first」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm coming too!」

name: Helena
message: 「You must be exhausted from the fight just now. Leave things to me today and get some proper rest」

name: Ria
message: 「But……」

name: Synn
message: 「If Senpai is going, then I am too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Me too!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I shall accompany you!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I can still keep going~!」

name: Helena
message: 「See, what did I tell you. Tamiko-chan. Sorry to bother you, but please take care of everyone」

name: Riesling
message: 「Leave seeing them safely home to me, Riesling Tohyama」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, wh-whoa!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「G-Grandpa~~!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Good grief…… Their legs are shaking like leaves, yet they sure know how to talk big……」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, that strong willpower…… To think I'd end up being encouraged by all of you」

name: Helena
message: 「Now that it's come to this, 'that power' really is going to be the key. Melilot……」
